Cutting $300B from SNAP isn’t about “sacrificing families” - it’s about slashing bureaucratic bloat. The Nutrition Assistance Reform Act (H.R. 5108) exposes how 37% of SNAP funds get diverted to admin costs and fraud instead of actual food. California’s Market Match program burned $35M last year on redundant EBT systems while farmers saw pennies.

Real reform means redirecting cash to border security, veterans’ care, and crushing inflation - not subsidizing failed state programs. Farmers markets thrive when Washington stops laundering taxpayer money through 8 layers of red tape.
@DorisMatsui You all need to get your facts straight!

Medicaid’s collapse isn’t about cuts—it’s about structural theft. The Big Beautiful Bill (H.R. 1) exposes how decades of bureaucratic bloat and unchecked illegal immigration drained resources meant for veterans and seniors. Every dollar spent on non-citizens through ER loopholes or state-level fraud is stolen from taxpayers.

Real reform requires slashing pharma overpayments, ending Medicaid’s role as a global handout, and prioritizing Americans who paid into the system.

D.C. dysfunction created this crisis—now they’re scrambling to fix it after letting billions vanish into consultant networks and asylum abuse.
